query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM dept_manager)
SELECT emp_no, first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM dept_manager WHERE dept_no='d005') ORDER BY emp_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM dept_manager WHERE dept_no IN (SELECT dept_no FROM departments WHERE dept_name='Development'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM titles t WHERE t.emp_no=e.emp_no AND t.title='Senior Engineer')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE emp_no NOT IN (SELECT emp_no FROM dept_manager)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE emp_no <= 10050 AND emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM dept_emp WHERE dept_no='d001')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e JOIN dept_emp de ON e.emp_no=de.emp_no JOIN departments d ON de.dept_no=d.dept_no WHERE d.dept_name='Development'
SELECT 'employees' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS c FROM employees UNION ALL SELECT 'salaries', COUNT(*) FROM salaries UNION ALL SELECT 'titles', COUNT(*) FROM titles
SELECT de.dept_no, COUNT(DISTINCT de.emp_no) AS c FROM dept_emp de GROUP BY de.dept_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT de.emp_no) > 20000 ORDER BY de.dept_no
SELECT DISTINCT title FROM titles ORDER BY title LIMIT 3 OFFSET 2
SELECT YEAR(hire_date) AS y, COUNT(*) AS c FROM employees GROUP BY y ORDER BY y
SELECT emp_no, from_date, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY emp_no ORDER BY from_date DESC) AS rn FROM salaries WHERE emp_no <= 10010 ORDER BY emp_no, rn
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, s.salary, s.from_date FROM employees e JOIN salaries s ON e.emp_no=s.emp_no WHERE e.emp_no=10001 ORDER BY s.from_date
SELECT * FROM employees WHERE emp_no=10001
SELECT e.emp_no, e.first_name, (SELECT MAX(s.salary) FROM salaries s WHERE s.emp_no=e.emp_no) AS max_sal FROM employees e WHERE e.emp_no <= 10010 ORDER BY e.emp_no
SELECT e.emp_no FROM employees e WHERE e.emp_no <= 10050 AND e.emp_no IN (SELECT de.emp_no FROM dept_emp de WHERE de.emp_no=e.emp_no AND de.dept_no='d005') ORDER BY e.emp_no
WITH RECURSIVE seq(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM seq WHERE n < 100) SELECT COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(n) AS s FROM seq
SELECT a.emp_no, a.dept_no AS d1, b.dept_no AS d2 FROM dept_emp a JOIN dept_emp b ON a.emp_no=b.emp_no AND a.dept_no < b.dept_no WHERE a.emp_no <= 10100 ORDER BY a.emp_no LIMIT 20
SELECT dept_no FROM departments WHERE dept_no <= 'd004' UNION SELECT dept_no FROM departments WHERE dept_no >= 'd006' ORDER BY dept_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees

WITH a AS (SELECT dept_no, COUNT(*) AS c FROM dept_emp GROUP BY dept_no), b AS (SELECT dept_no, dept_name FROM departments) SELECT b.dept_name, a.c FROM a JOIN b ON a.dept_no=b.dept_no ORDER BY b.dept_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE first_name='Parto'

SELECT x.dept_no, x.c FROM (SELECT dept_no, COUNT(*) AS c FROM dept_emp GROUP BY dept_no) x ORDER BY x.dept_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e LEFT JOIN dept_manager dm ON e.emp_no=dm.emp_no WHERE dm.emp_no IS NULL
SELECT dept_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM departments d JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no=de.dept_no GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY d.dept_name
SELECT gender, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salaries WHERE salary > 100000
WITH hs AS (SELECT emp_no, MAX(salary) AS ms FROM salaries GROUP BY emp_no) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hs WHERE ms > 140000
SELECT title, COUNT(*) FROM titles GROUP BY title ORDER BY title
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salaries WHERE salary BETWEEN 60000 AND 70000
SELECT AVG(salary) FROM salaries
SELECT SUM(salary) FROM salaries

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salaries WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM salaries)

SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(s.salary) FROM departments d JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no=de.dept_no JOIN salaries s ON de.emp_no=s.emp_no GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY d.dept_name
